description: This file defines a React component 'ScheduleEventModal' for scheduling calendar events, including generating ICS files, integrating with Google Calendar, and providing UI steps for calendar import. It also includes helper components for buttons and step instructions.

classes.name: CalendarButton
classes.description: A button component for calendar options with icon and label.

classes.name: CalendarSteps
classes.description: Component displaying step-by-step instructions for calendar import and download.

methods.name: generateRoadmapIcsFile
methods.description: Creates an ICS calendar file Blob with event details and reminders.

methods.name: handleDownloadICS
methods.description: Handles the download of ICS file, generating the calendar event and triggering download.

methods.name: triggerScheduleEvent
methods.description: Logs or fires an event for scheduling analytics.

methods.name: handleGoogleCalendar
methods.description: Prepares and opens Google Calendar event creation URL.
